1) the clickthrough data from a commercial search engine is biased towards results with more "attractive" titles and 2) the attractiveness of a result's title is correlated with the number of queries that the result is clicked for, the number of clicks the result receives and the number of times the result is displayed.
attractive titles are associated with higher clickthrough rates and that attractive results are more likely to be clicked on than unattractive results with similar relevance.
